test_match_to_schema_basic: test match_to_schema matches a lazyframe to an exact schema and returns the original dataframe
test_match_to_schema_missing_columns: test match_to_schema inserts missing columns with null values when missing_columns is set to insert
test_match_to_schema_extra_columns: test match_to_schema ignores extra columns when extra_columns is set to ignore
test_match_to_schema_missing_struct_fiel: test match_to_schema inserts missing struct fields with null values when missing_struct_fields is set to insert
test_match_to_schema_extra_struct_fields: test match_to_schema ignores extra struct fields when extra_struct_fields is set to ignore
test_match_to_schema_integer_upcast: test match_to_schema upcasts integer types when integer_cast is set to upcast
test_match_to_schema_float_upcast: test match_to_schema upcasts float types when float_cast is set to upcast
